storage.notes: SD/SDHC/SDXC card slot (max 2 TB SDXC); iSCSI / VRM recording

features: Intelligent Tracking with on-board Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA)
92 dB WDR, sodium vapor white balance, SensUp
Mechanical day/night (IR-cut filter removed in low light); no IR illuminator
256 pre-positions, preset tours and 2 recorded tours
Pan 360 deg continuous, pre-position speed pan 400 deg/s, tilt 300 deg/s, accuracy +/-0.1 deg
Quad streaming (CPP4, H.264 + M-JPEG), SD resolution
Plenum rated in-ceiling housing (IK8 with optional polycarbonate bubble)
7 alarm inputs / 4 alarm outputs, audio line in/out (full duplex)

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_7000_Series_Data_sheet_enUS_11388903435.pdf). In-ceiling 28x SD model. VG5-7028-C1PC4 = PAL with clear bubble; VG5-7028-C2PT4 = NTSC with tinted bubble (the datasheet heading for C2PT4 is misprinted as "C1PC4 ... NTSC with Tinted Bubble"). Sensitivity: colour 0.33 lux / mono 0.066 lux at 30 IRE with SensUp off. Resolution 704x480 on NTSC. Operating temperature -10 to 40 C (or -10 to 55 C without heater connected in the power supply box). Power consumption 24 W / 44 VA typical. Pendant (E1PC4/E2PC4) and 36x (VG5-7036) models in this datasheet are separate cameras and not covered by this record.
